newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Sheffield Shield close of play scores.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Sheffield Shield close of play scores.

text.p: Results and close of play scores in four-day Sheffield Shield matches on Sunday.

In Melbourne (final day): Victoria beat New South Wales by two wickets. New South Wales 290 and 264-8 declared (Rod Davison 88). Victoria 164 and 391-8 (Graeme Vampini 161, Ian Harvey 88, Matthew Elliott 65).
In Brisbane (final day): Queensland drew with Western Australia. Queensland 179 and 412 (Trevor Barsby 107). Western Australia 183 and 273 for five (Tom Moody 136, Simon Katich 65 not out).
